title: Audit log: sys_user_preference writes are not audit events
body:
Ruled: 6212163130 · letter B · 2026-10-16T09:13Z

## Source

Read in the console's Setup app on 2026-10-16 (objectstack `18.0.0-next.1` serving HotCRM): Audit Logs (`sys_audit_log`, 407 rows) opens on thirteen consecutive rows `update · sys_user_preference · TAnQGzKwsF3QeY3X · Dev Admin` between 10:58 and 11:01 — one per list preference change (a column hidden, a sort toggled, a favourite pinned: `ui.recent`, `ui.favorites`, `ui.flow.palette.recents`), written by the console's own UI state store. The System Overview dashboard counts them as "Config Changes / Events": 123 of the 189 events in seven days are `update`, most of them this object. The rows that matter (login, permission and sharing changes, record deletes) are buried under a user's clicks.

## Target

1. The audit plugin (`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-plugin.ts`) does not record writes to `sys_user_preference`; the exclusion is declared on the object (an `audit: false` posture on the platform object, or an allowlist the plugin reads), not hard-coded by name in the plugin.
2. The same posture applies to the other per-user UI stores the console writes on every interaction (recent items, favourites, palette recents) — one declaration, read by the plugin.
3. The System Overview dashboard's "Config Changes" tile reads `config_change` actions only, which it already does; with the exclusion its "Events by User" chart stops counting preference writes.

## File surface

`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-plugin.ts` (the write hook and the object filter), `packages/platform-objects/src/…/sys-user-preference.object.ts` (the posture flag), the spec if the flag is new (`packages/spec`, declared before it is read), tests beside each.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: an update to `sys_user_preference` writes no `sys_audit_log` row; an update to `sys_sharing_rule` still does; a new object with the flag set is skipped.
2. On a dev instance, after ten list-preference changes, `sys_audit_log` gains zero rows (the epic PM reads it in Setup).
3. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit test` green; the spec gate green if the flag is new.

## Constraints

- Compliance posture: the exclusion covers UI preference stores only; no business or security object may opt out through the same flag without an ADR — the flag's docblock says so.

## Evidence

Screenshots on the temporary branch `claude/console-home-login-design-20261016` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `01244b886`, never merged): [setup-audit-logs.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/01244b886/docs/design/setup-review-2026-10-16/setup-audit-logs.png?raw=true).

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 second review pass: objectui main `8415d9f11`, HotCRM `63db83e2`, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack serve --dev` on :4001, the Studio pillars and all 43 Setup pages walked in the maintainer's browser pane at 1024 × 768 (en) with a 1280 × 900 re-check (zh). The maintainer asked for every finding to be filed, verbatim: 「全部立卡」.</sub>
